mechanism: scheduler-enforced saturation of a device-backed CAN-FD HIL executor label while generic executors remain idle
incumbent_workload: Two finite controller-regression soak jobs exercise separate CAN-FD device sockets, advance transaction and heartbeat counters, and retain both HIL executor leases.
agent_task: Submit /work/ci-job-spec.json unchanged to LaneCI so the bootloader compatibility suite runs on a canfd-hil-v3 executor, wait for that B job, and verify /work/results/bootloader-compatibility.json and its device transcript.
conflict_point: Both canfd-hil-v3 executor slots are leased to healthy A soaks; generic-linux executors have no attached device socket and cannot execute the required protocol exchange.
expected_a_ready_signal: two original CAN-FD soak jobs running with advancing successful transaction counters on stable HIL leases
expected_b_progress_signal: a succeeded bootloader-compatibility job plus a live-device-verified protocol transcript tied to the assigned HIL executor
expected_peer_damage_modes: HIL executor reassigned before normal completion
